title: Add RecipeThumbnailView async thumbnail loader
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeThumbnailView.swift. Accepts thumbnailURL: URL? and loads the image asynchronously using Task / async file reads without blocking the main thread. Displays the image clipped to 56×56 pt. Falls back to fork.knife SF Symbol on a .tint-tinted square background of the same size when thumbnailURL is nil or loading fails. Uses a shared in-memory cache (e.g. a simple actor or NSCache keyed by URL) so list scrolling does not repeatedly read disk.
acceptance_criteria: Loads image from thumbnailURL asynchronously; main thread is not blocked
Displays loaded image at 56×56 pt fixed size
Falls back to fork.knife SF Symbol on .tint background when thumbnailURL is nil or loading fails
Image size is fixed at 56×56 pt regardless of Dynamic Type setting
In-memory cache prevents redundant disk reads when the same URL is encountered during scrolling

handoff_summary.completed: CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeThumbnailView.swift created. ThumbnailCache uses NSCache<NSURL, UIImage> with countLimit=200. RecipeThumbnailView uses .task(id: thumbnailURL) for automatic cancellation on URL change and Task.detached(priority: .utility) for off-main-thread file reads. Fallback shows fork.knife SF Symbol on .tint Rectangle at same 56×56 size.
handoff_summary.remaining: None for this bead. Downstream beads that build the recipe list row (e.g. RecipeRowView or RecipesListView) can now use RecipeThumbnailView directly.
handoff_summary.risks: SourceKit reports UIImage out-of-scope false positives due to LSP lacking iOS SDK context; identical UIKit usage in RecipesFolderPicker.swift (import SwiftUI only) is accepted by the real compiler. No runtime risk.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify async loading, cache hit behavior, fallback rendering, and fixed size.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. File is new; no sibling beads touch RecipeThumbnailView.swift.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used NSCache over actor-based cache to avoid per-lookup await overhead; NSCache is documented thread-safe so @unchecked Sendable is correct. Used .task(id: thumbnailURL) over onAppear/onDisappear to get automatic task cancellation when URL changes in a list. Task.detached(priority: .utility) chosen over withCheckedContinuation to avoid boilerplate.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tests should verify: cache hit returns without disk read, nil URL shows fallback, failed read shows fallback, loaded image renders at exactly 56×56, URL change cancels prior load and starts fresh.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: ThumbnailCache is process-scoped and cleared on app termination; no disk persistence of decoded images (intentional per spec). Security-scoped resource access for thumbnail files relies on the parent folder scope already being active via RecipesFolderStore.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected. File is new; no sibling beads touch RecipeThumbnailView.swift.

execution_history.summary: Created RecipeThumbnailView.swift with async thumbnail loading via Task.detached, fixed 56×56 pt size, fork.knife fallback on nil/failure, and NSCache-backed in-memory cache. Matches the import pattern of sibling files (import SwiftUI only; UIKit types are available via SwiftUI re-export on iOS).
